prompt: Explain why testing AI responses matters in a customer-support product.
evidence: AI response evaluations can help identify inaccurate or incomplete answers before they reach customers.
Testing different responses helps teams compare instruction following, relevance, and writing quality.

responses.response: - Testing improves reliability by helping teams identify inaccurate or incomplete answers.\n- Teams can compare relevance and instruction following before customers see the response.
AI answers are always perfect. Testing may help.
